title: Almost-primes in Sun's $x^2+ny^2$ conjecture
summary: In 2015 Zhi-Wei Sun proposed the conjecture that any integer $n > 1$ admits a partition $n = x + y$ with integers $x, y >0$ such that $x + ny$ and $x^2 + ny^2$ are simultaneously prime. To approach this conjecture we use the method of weighted sieve as developed by Richert, Halberstam, and Diamond. In this article, we first formalize the conjecture into a sieve problem. We verify that the conditions required to use Richert's weighted sieve are satisfied and establish partial results with almost-prime solutions for sufficiently large $n$.
